metadata.title: The Khronon Route: the Blanchet-Skordis Theory Through Two Gates, and a Cubic, One-Scale Khronon That Passes Them
metadata.description:
The relativistic khronon theory of Blanchet and Skordis (JCAP 11 (2024) 040) is run, on its own equations, through the two gates that closed this programme's previous completion (PAPER32), and then repaired.

Moving source: passed. The phantom is a conserved fluid carried by the aether, and a galaxy moving uniformly with its phantom is an exact post-Newtonian solution. The costs are three. The phantom is assembled rather than generated. It follows a change of velocity only inside r ~ 2GM_b/du^2. The static halo is stable only for a monotone phantom law, while any GR-recovering tail is unstable where it falls, at the local orbital rate.

KiDS external field and sigma_8: failed as built. The MOND function reads the gradient of the khronon's own potential. The benchmark mu^-1 = 22.3 Mpc puts 24 times the KiDS-1000 bound on it. The benchmark 223 kpc passes, but its mass term ends MOND-like lensing at ~80 kpc, and no mu passes both. The theory's own scale-dependent sound speed gives linear sigma_8 ~ 0.21-0.26.

Diagnosis and repair. All three cosmological failures come from the quadratic term of the kinetic function K(Q). With K starting at cubic order the galactic mass term vanishes (pure AQUAL statics), and the Jeans length stays short at every epoch. For late Jeans lengths of 0.3-3 kpc: sigma_8 = 0.811, forest-scale power within 2%, a web field in the MOND function <= 1.5e-7 a0, and early w <= 4e-6, with the moving phantom kept.

The programme's relation. With a one-scale MOND function J = Lambda j(Y/Lambda), a0 = kappa c sqrt(G rho_Lambda) is an identity of the action, with kappa = 2 sqrt(8 pi)/(3 beta). kappa = 1/2 corresponds to beta = 4 sqrt(8 pi)/3, and Planck's Lambda then returns a0 = 9.35e-11 m/s^2. kappa is not derived.

Open: the conserved phantom's mass budget at Mpc radii, the stability of the GR-recovery tail, and the cubic term's strong coupling. A candidate that passes the gates computed, not a theory. AI-assisted research programme; not peer reviewed; nothing is claimed closed.
